Welcome to the independent '''MirkLurk Wiki'''. Find equipment, creatures, characters, skills, and the systems behind your journey.

== Explore ==
* [[Items]] - equipment, materials, and supplies; open an item for its documented stats and relationships
* [[Bestiary]] - creatures and enemies
* [[NPCs]] - characters, including merchants and their documented wares
* [[Nature]] - plants, terrain, and other nature records
* [[Skills]] - browse skill groups and individual skill mechanics
* [[Damage types]] - damage, status effects, armor interactions, and remedies
* [[Health and armor]] - reading health shapes and attack grids
* [[Action points]] - action costs, turns, and equipping items
* [[Game mechanics]] - weather, progression, crafting, and other researched systems

== Read the caveats ==
Catalogues may reveal names before you encounter them in play. A source entry is not proof that content is available in the current game. [[Evidence and spoilers|Read the spoiler and build caveats]].

Missing information means unknown, not zero. See [[Game mechanics#Version|the documented game version]] when comparing behavior.

== Help improve the wiki ==
Add original explanations and cite evidence. [[Research policy|How to contribute and interpret evidence]] | [[Source provenance|Research sources]].
